matches.tactical_summary: Spain dominated possession and pressed relentlessly, quickly settling the match with three first-half goals. Their sharp passing and high tempo overwhelmed Saudi Arabia, who struggled to cope with Spain's movement and intensity.

narrative: Spain bounced back from their opening draw with a dominant 4-0 victory over Saudi Arabia, with Lamine Yamal and Mikel Oyarzabal leading the charge. This commanding performance has significantly boosted Spain's position at the top of Group H, while Saudi Arabia faces an uphill battle after their second match.
